# A garden for trying on new looks

This small site is intentionally dense. It gives every bundled theme the same
content, relationships, and feature states so visual changes are easy to spot.

## Start exploring

- [[components|Component gallery]] exercises long-form content, tables,
  code, media, and the table of contents.
- [[notes/callouts|Callout conservatory]] contains every canonical callout type.
- [[notes/connections|Connected notes]] and [[journal/first-entry|The first journal entry]]
  create visible backlinks and a useful knowledge graph.
- [[projects/glasshouse|Glasshouse project]] adds another section, tag overlap,
  and a different growth state.

## A short quotation

> A garden is never finished; it simply reaches another season.
>
> — A patient gardener

## Small details

Inline `code`, **strong text**, *emphasis*, [an external link](https://example.org),
and a footnote all belong in the baseline.[^baseline]

[^baseline]: The fixture favors stable, synthetic content over product documentation.
